_provenance: Operator-maintained classification of common X12 CARC codes. The code numbers and short meanings below are the widely published industry-standard set; the `category`, `appealable` and `action` fields are OUR classification, not part of the standard. VERIFY the full current list against the official X12 CARC/RARC publication before the first paid client delivery. Any code not present here is classified `unknown` and is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
